lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of vertically aligned columns consisting of 4 to 6 high-luminance circular nodes; the nodes are distributed in a geometric grid pattern across the mid-lateral flank posterior to the pectoral fin.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: High-intensity vertical bands intersect with horizontal alignments of spots to form a lattice-like structure where the spots serve as high-luminance nodes on the vertical stripe axes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible along the upper and mid-lateral flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical intensity gradient with specular highlights on the superior edge and deep shadowing on the inferior edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of approximately 8-10 small, high-luminance blobs localized primarily on the lower-posterior quadrant of the first dorsal fin's silhouette.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent V-shaped truncation/notch at the apex of the first dorsal fin and irregular erosion of the trailing edge; possible small lesion or parasite attachment at the base of the pectoral fin.
